high_level_description: This image is a minimalist illustration featuring elements from the Star Wars universe. The background is entirely black, which makes the white line art stand out prominently. At the top of the image, there is a stylized depiction of the Death Star, a large spherical space station that serves as a central command for the Galactic Empire in the Star Wars series. Below the Death Star, there is a formation of smaller ships, which appear to be TIE fighters, a type of starfighter used by the Imperial Navy.
